rows.behavior: an event whose write OpenViking answers with a lock-timeout 409 is redelivered with the usual backoff and logs an INFO 'folder busy' line naming the URI, and no WARN
rows.fails_when: the event is acked, dead-lettered before its last try, NAKed with a different delay than Backoff(delivered), logs at WARN, or logs no INFO line with the URI

rows.behavior: a 409 that is not a lock timeout still logs WARN 'event failed', and a lock-timeout 409 on the last allowed try still dead-letters
rows.fails_when: the other 409 logs at INFO, or the last-try lock 409 is not dead-lettered

rows.behavior: a catch-up folder delete that hits a lock-timeout 409 logs it as folder busy instead of failing the pass with that error
rows.fails_when: the catch-up pass error or WARN log carries the lock-timeout 409

rows.behavior: both roots pin ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1, the module tests and vet pass, and the repo gates pass
rows.fails_when: either ov_sync_consumer_image line names another tag, or the module tests, vet or just pre_commit fail
rows.command: grep -q 'ov_sync_consumer_image *= "ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1"' deployments/applications/services.tf && grep -q 'ov_sync_consumer_image *= "ghcr.io/jasperhg90/ov-sync-consumer:v0.1.1"' deployments/infrastructure/services.tf && just -f applications/ov-sync-consumer/justfile test && just pre_commit

rows.behavior: after the operator releases v0.1.1 and applies, a burst sync logs lock 409s only as INFO 'folder busy' lines
rows.fails_when: the consumer log shows a WARN 'event failed' line caused by a lock-timeout 409
